page.layout: One page of text, single column; heading "AD LECTOREM." at top; catchword-like signature "GEOR-" at lower right below the text.

p.i: Collegi enim jamdudum omnia ejus orbis quæ supersunt, monumentorum fragmenta & multa obliterata penitus aliisque neglecta observavi, ex quibus antiquitates illarum gentium tot secu-lis ignoratarum & res gestæ, quantum fieri potest, restituantur. Ad Saracenica Drechsleri mirum in modum depravata & corrupta, breves adjeci notas errorum indices, quibus Orientalium Historiæ hinc inde illustrentur. Neque enim operæpretium erat in hoc opusculo, vel prolixiorem esse vel accuratiorem, id quod Chronologia nostræ Regiæ ex professo & cum cura reservamus. Vale, Lector Benevole, & his, qualiacunque sint, interea fruere.

page.notes: Small cropped marks at the lower left and bottom edge are not text. The catchword "GEOR-" is printed at the lower right; its hyphen is printed. Long s has been normalised to s; the printed text uses long s throughout.
